patch_description: The current 4-distinct-parameter version (ry_a, rz, zz_ring, plus implicit split) scored lower (0.70) than the simpler 2-distinct-parameter design (ry_a, theta) that scored 0.74. Since parameter economy is heavily rewarded and the 2-param design also generalizes better (higher worst-group margin trend), revert to the proven 2-parameter structure (single "ry_a" pre-rotation, single "theta" shared across RZ layers, ZZ ring/opposite/skip-2 shells, XX ring, CNOT ladders) and extend it with the recommended skip-3 ZZ shell (distance-3 pairs: [0,3],[1,4],[2,5],[3,6],[4,7],[5,0],[6,1],[7,2]) reusing "theta". This densifies long-range entanglement further without adding any new trainable parameter, aiming to tighten the worst-group margin while keeping n_distinct_params at 2.
